Hi Sanjay — great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery:

- Key goals you shared: reduce inference latency for batch reports, centralize model governance across clinics, and cap monthly inference cost.
- Users who'd join the technical deep dive: you, Emma (CTO), and one of your infra engineers.
- Helpful context: current peak inference windows are 08:00–11:00 PT and 16:00–19:00 CET.

To make the deep dive accessible across Medivue's global teams, we propose a rotating 3-zone demo cadence (one week each for US, EU, APAC friendly windows). That keeps the same team from Redwood available but moves the meeting times so every Medivue stakeholder gets a reasonable local hour on rotation.

Attached: discovery-notes-medivue.pdf (notes from today). Also attached a short CSV with an example 3-zone rotor and local time conversions (3zone-rotor-proposal.csv).

Proposed immediate options (pick one or suggest alternatives):
- Option A (US-first week): Tue 08:30–09:30 PT / Tue 16:30–17:30 CET / Wed 00:30–01:30 SGT (UTC+8) — good if US team leads first deep dive
- Option B (EU-first week): Wed 15:00–16:00 CET / Wed 07:00–08:00 PT / Thu 23:00–00:00 SGT — good if Emma prefers earlier CET slot
- Option C (APAC-first week): Thu 09:00–10:00 SGT / Wed 18:00–19:00 CET / Wed 10:00–11:00 PT — helpful if APAC engineers need daytime access

If any of these look close, I can send calendar invites for a 60-minute technical deep dive and loop in Karthik (our solutions engineer) and Marissa for a quick pre-call alignment if needed.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm preferred option or share 2–3 windows that work for Emma and the infra lead.
2) I’ll coordinate availability with Karthik and confirm the final slot.
3) We’ll run the 60-minute deep dive with a short 15-minute followup the week after for open questions.

Thanks — excited to keep this moving.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: discovery-notes-medivue.pdf (1 page), 3zone-rotor-proposal.csv (sample schedule)
